title: Cantonese-Style Bacon and Lardon Stir-Fry
description: A savory and aromatic stir-fry made with crispy bacon and lardon, served with a side of steamed vegetables. This dish is gluten-free, making it a great option for those with dietary restrictions.

ingredients.name: Vegetables (such as broccoli, carrots, and bell peppers)
ingredients.notes: any combination of your favorite vegetables

ingredients.name: Cooking oil
ingredients.notes: such as peanut or vegetable oil

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the sliced bacon and cook until crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced lardon and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the Cantonese stir-fry sauce and stir to combine.
Add the steamed vegetables and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until they are tender-crisp.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
